name: GDS stack: nvidia-fs, cuFile configs, gdscheck, and the KvikIO environment

tasks.name: nvidia-fs loaded and at least 2.24.2; built from source at a pinned tag when the AMI has none
commands: if ! lsmod | grep -q '^nvidia_fs' && ! modprobe nvidia_fs 2>/dev/null; then echo 'no nvidia-fs module for this kernel; building it (the apt package would pull another kernel and driver)' | tee $D/nvfs-source.txt; rm -rf /opt/campaign/src/gds-nvidia-fs; git clone -q --depth 1 -b $NVFS_REF https://github.com/NVIDIA/gds-nvidia-fs.git /opt/campaign/src/gds-nvidia-fs; test "$(git -C /opt/campaign/src/gds-nvidia-fs rev-parse HEAD)" = "$NVFS_COMMIT"; cd /opt/campaign/src/gds-nvidia-fs/src && export NVFS_MAX_PEER_DEVS=128 NVFS_MAX_PCI_DEPTH=16 && make -j$(nproc) > $D/nvfs-make.txt 2>&1 && insmod nvidia-fs.ko; fi
V=$(grep -oE 'NVFS Driver\(version: *[0-9.]+' /proc/driver/nvidia-fs/stats | grep -oE '[0-9.]+$'); echo nvidia-fs=$V | tee -a $D/nvfs-version.txt
python3 -c "import sys; v=tuple(map(int,'$V'.split('.'))); sys.exit(0 if v>=(2,24,2) else 1)"
for k in rw_stats_enabled peer_stats_enabled; do [ -w /sys/module/nvidia_fs/parameters/$k ] && echo 1 > /sys/module/nvidia_fs/parameters/$k || true; done

tasks.name: cufile.json variants: default and strict (no compat fallback)
commands: SRC=/etc/cufile.json; [ -f $SRC ] || SRC=$(ls /usr/local/cuda*/gds/cufile.json | sort -V | tail -1); echo src=$SRC | tee $D/source.txt

tasks.name: gdscheck -p under the default config, after /fsx is mounted
uv venv with KvikIO and CuPy matched to the driver's CUDA major version
commands: command -v uv || (curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | env UV_INSTALL_DIR=/usr/local/bin sh)
CU=$(nvidia-smi | grep -oE 'CUDA Version: [0-9]+' | grep -oE '[0-9]+$'); echo cuda-major=$CU | tee $OUT/stack/cuda-major.txt
if [ "$CU" -ge 13 ]; then S=cu13; C=cuda13x; else S=cu12; C=cuda12x; fi
uv pip install -p $VENV/bin/python kvikio-$S==$KVIKIO_VERSION cupy-$C==$CUPY_VERSION numpy
$VENV/bin/python -c 'import kvikio, cupy; print("kvikio", kvikio.__version__, "cupy", cupy.__version__)' | tee $OUT/stack/imports.txt
